## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 345 captures during July 2019. This represents the activity completed at the site for the month and provides the operational basis for the image-quality and grading measures reported below. The capture total should be reviewed alongside the number of images available for assessment, as any images that cannot be graded affect the interpretation of subsequent results.

## Image quality

There were 13 ungradable images, giving an ungradable rate of 3.8 per cent. This measure should continue to be monitored through routine site review. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that equipment concerns can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

A total of 49 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 1 day. These figures should be considered together when reviewing the service’s performance for July 2019, with attention given to both the volume of referable findings and the time taken for grading. Ongoing monitoring will support identification of any recurring issues affecting image capture, image quality, or grading turnaround at Harbour Eye Clinic.
